entries.note: scripts/probe-surface.mjs and scripts/lint-shell.mjs share an ES-module import header plus the one-line repo-root computation. Reviewed and classified rather than removed, because removing it made things worse by this gate's own measure: extracting repoRootFrom() into scripts/lib/ and converting all ten call sites turned one family into three, since every rewritten header then carried the same extra import. It also broke the install-git-hooks scratch-clone test, which needs that script self-contained. Import statements are not extractable; this is portable boilerplate.
